equation_summary: AttnRes aggregates previous-layer residual sources over the DEPTH domain. Each residual source v_l is RMSNorm-ed (rms_weight) to form k_l; logits p_l = softmax_over_depth( (k_l . (query*scale)) ) with softmax over dim=0 (the residual-source / depth axis); output o = sum_l p_l * v_l (unnormalized v, not the normed k). An optional output RMSNorm (output_rms_weight) fuses the following prenorm. Depth is the source domain, NOT sequence; there is no sequence state or causal mask.
state_shape: no sequence state; operates over a stack [L,...,D] of L residual sources, query [D]
normalization: softmax over the depth/source axis (RMSNorm on keys, optional RMSNorm on output)
